items.title: Binance hackers raced to move billions before it could be frozen
items.summary: Attackers raced to convert stolen stablecoins into crypto that issuers could not freeze as industry players like Tether and Circle moved to immobilize billions of dollars in assets.

items.title: IPX Unveils Patent-Pending Atomic Router: Protected Capital in the Bonding Curve, Coinbase-Funded Rewards and Automatic Graduation Into Liquid Markets
items.summary: IPX today detailed its patent-pending atomic router, the technology at the heart of its protocol, ahead of the launch of the IPX OS, IPX Exchange and the $IPX token on Base Nov 17.

items.title: Inside the largest crypto hack on record: How attackers breached Binance for $6.3 billion
items.summary: Investigators tie the $6B Binance hack to North Korea.

items.title: Binance Hack Shows Why Offshore Exchanges Need US Oversight, CFTC Chair Says
items.summary: Michael Selig said the record $6.4 billion theft shows why offshore exchanges should register with the CFTC and adopt U.S.-grade cybersecurity standards.
